wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Lagoon Town |image=Lagoon Town.png |imagesize=250px |characters=ラーグンタウン |japanese=Lagoon Town |region=Kalos |epicode=XY047 |episode=Dreaming a Performer's Dream! }} '''Lagoon Town''' (Japanese: '''ラーグンタウン''' ''Lagoon Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Kalos]] [[region]]. It is located between [[Shalour City]] and [[Coumarine City]]. It has a theater where [[Pokémon Showcase]]s are held. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arranged a meeting there with {{an|Shauna}}, who wanted to tell them something. When they met up in ''[[XY047|Dreaming a Performer's Dream!]]'', Shauna informed them that {{DL|Pokémon Performer|Kalos Queen}} {{an|Aria}} would give an exhibition performance at the Pokémon Showcase Rookie Class held that day. After Aria's performance, a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Pancham}} ran onto the stage and interrupted the performance of [[Kayleigh]].
